{{Quote|This is Palmer on the southern ridge. We've picked up Trade Federation forces moving our way, fast.|Palmer|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''</ref>}}
The '''Naboo airbase''' was utilized by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] during the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. It was placed near the south ridge of the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and consisted of a [[security hangar]] and several buildings. It was [[Battle of the south ridge|attacked]] during the latter stages of the invasion.

==Description==
The base was established by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] and became part of the [[Naboo Resistance|resistance movement]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">The video game itself refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the invasion happens in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> It rested a cliff near the south ridge of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] capital [[City/Legends|city]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. [[Widow's Valley]] was nearby, as was [[Rasker Hill]]. A [[bridge]] led to the base from the lower plains. The base's primary characteristic was a [[security hangar]], with a barracks and two smaller buildings next to it.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==History==
During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the Naboo Security Forces met with the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] to retake the planet. At the meeting, they formulated a plan to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|retake]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The Security Forces would enter Theed while the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|engaged]] the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. The Federation sent three [[Army/Legends|Army]] units to destroy the Gungans. [[Army C]]<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels">Army C was given an indirect mention in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]'' in the entry for the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]</ref> passed near this base, and the base came under attack. [[Palmer (Royal Naboo Security Forces)|Palmer]], a [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] at the base, called for assistance. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] received her distress call and moved to engage the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]]. Sykes destroyed the Federation [[Laser turret (Trade Federation)|laser cannons]] blocking the bridge and was able to knock out the two tanks. He then entered the base's hangar on the order of [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]], the highest ranking Naboo officer. Sykes took an experimental [[NB-1S Royal Bomber|bomber]], which he used to delay Army C in Widow's Valley, thereby contributing to the final victory. At that time, two [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] and a [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|Flash speeder]] were parked at the base.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
The base appears in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. It is necessary to save the base before taking the bomber and attacking the convoy. If any of the buildings are destroyed, the mission ends in failure.
